thesis: Bitcoin is the right horse in the crypto book - it is where the flows are consolidating while altcoin funds bleed - but it is chopping in a $77-82k range with no breakout, RSI 53, and a live Fed hike eight days out. Owning it is defensible; adding to it here is paying the spread for a coin flip.
bull_case: Flows are unambiguous and dated: US spot bitcoin ETFs took $3.52B in August, their strongest month of 2026, and extended the positive-flow streak to three consecutive weeks with $986.9M in the week ended 4 Sep. The contrast with the rest of our crypto book is the point - inflows into ETH, SOL, XRP and Hyperliquid products fell 73-96% over the same week. Combined US bitcoin ETF net assets are $103.34B, about 6.32% of market cap, so this is structural allocation rather than a trading flow. Packet: close 78,525.9, close > SMA50 > SMA200, 63d momentum +24.0%, ATR 2.9% - the calmest crypto we hold.
bear_case: Price is going nowhere. Bitcoin ran from below $63k to above $81k on a short squeeze and has since slipped toward $77-78k, roughly flat over seven days - we are marked -0.2% on an entry made yesterday. The packet flags no breakout, and RSI 53 is the middle of the range, which is the worst place to add. The macro is actively against it: fed funds futures put a hike at 58-66% for 15-16 Sep, the 10-year sat at 4.796% and the 2-year at 4.394% on 8 Sep, and rising oil keeps the inflation impulse alive. ETF flows are also more two-sided than the headline: $731M in on 3 Sep followed $236M out on 1 Sep, and one report on the August record still opened September with a warning. Base rate from our own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4% with Sharpe -0.15, a 17% win rate over 75 trades and a -19.2% max drawdown. This system has not shown an edge trading crypto momentum, and that caps conviction here.
catalysts: 15-16 Sep 2026 FOMC decision and dot plot
Weekly US spot bitcoin ETF flow prints
August CPI ahead of the FOMC
Any Strait of Hormuz de-escalation easing the inflation impulse
risks: Range-bound $77-82k with no breakout and RSI 53
Hawkish Fed hike on 16 Sep with the 10-year near 4.8%
ETF flows are volatile week to week, not a one-way street
Own backtest: crypto sleeve -6.4%, Sharpe -0.15, 17% win rate
invalidation: Flips long on a daily close above 82,000 - a clean break of the range high made after the FOMC rather than before it - with ETF flows still positive. The bear case confirms on a close below 74,000, which breaks the range low and the SMA50 structure.
